catalog.description: Catalog implementation. Hive Metastore is deliberately absent: it has no maintained upstream Helm chart, so supporting it means owning a Deployment, and that is deferred until a consumer needs the Hive protocol.

password.description: Optional explicit password. When empty, one is generated and preserved across reconciles.

size.description: Persistent Volume size for catalog metadata.

host.description: Hostname for external access to the catalog API via Ingress. Leave empty to keep the catalog reachable only inside the cluster, which is the usual choice: engines connect over cluster DNS and nothing outside needs to speak the catalog protocol.

enabled.description: Run the GC CronJob. Off by default: the invocation has not been validated against a running catalog, and a job that deletes data files is the wrong place to guess.

retainSnapshotDays.description: Age below which content stays live. Data files unreferenced for longer become collectable, and time travel further back than this stops working.

schedule.description: Cron schedule for the GC run.

replicaCount.description: Number of catalog replicas. The service is stateless — all state is in Postgres — so this scales freely.

cpu.description: CPU available to the catalog pod.

memory.description: Memory available to the catalog pod.

resourcesPreset.description: Default sizing preset. Requests are derived from these limits through the platform's allocation ratios (cpu-allocation-ratio and friends from the cozystack config), so a preset states what the pod may use, not what it reserves. The catalog is a thin service over a database and is not where analytics load lands, so a small preset is right; the database behind it is sized separately.

readOnlyUser.description: Also issue a read-only credential alongside the read-write one, for engines that only query.

storagePool.description: Selects a specific BucketClass by storage pool name. Leave empty for the default.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the catalog's Postgres PVCs. Leave empty to use the cluster default.
